rca_of_the_issue.previous_bug: react-leaflet MapContainer threw 'Map container is already initialized' under React.StrictMode dev double-mount, crashing AdminDashboard.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied_by_main_agent: Replaced <MapContainer> with manual L.map() init inside a useEffect that guards against re-init via a ref and cleans up via map.remove() on unmount. Markers managed in a separate L.layerGroup updated by a second useEffect on drivers change.
